parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet address 10.20.20.20/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 设备的自治系统号，用于BGP等协议。

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external

set protocols bgp group external-peers p.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers peer-as 200
set protocols bgp group external-peers p.explanation: 配置BGP组的对等体自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 192.168.2.1

set protocols bgp group external-peers f.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv4单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers e.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers export redistribute-connected
set protocols bgp group external-peers e.explanation: 配置BGP组使用指定的导出策略。

set policy-options policy-statement redi.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件为直接连接的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置策略项的动作接受匹配的路由。
